post.title: A congresswoman's Nvidia buy is down 11% since
post.description:
Rep. Maria Elvira Salazar's STOCK Act filing shows three trades on Oct 23: an Nvidia (NVDA) buy, a Cisco (CSCO) sale and a Procter & Gamble (PG) buy, each $1K–$15K.

Oct 23 · NVDA · BUY · $1K–$15K
Oct 23 · CSCO · SELL · $1K–$15K
Oct 23 · PG · BUY · $1K–$15K

Disclosed Nov 5.

Since then (Oct 23 close → Nov 6 close): Nvidia −11.5%, Cisco −11.9%, Procter & Gamble +2.7%. Nvidia fell 9.3% in one day on Nov 5.

Also disclosed this week:
Sen. Shelley Moore Capito · Oct 21 · SELL · Apple, Microsoft, Meta, Zoetis · $1K–$15K each (disclosed Nov 5)
Rep. Daniel Meuser · Sep 25 · SELL · Nvidia · $1K–$15K (disclosed Nov 5)

Which trade surprised you most? Tell me in the comments.
